retrieval_policy.first_unit_dependency_policy: The prepared kickoff must remain completable using only the three local learner-safe documents and standard Python documentation already available to the learner.
classification_rules: Do not equate a cataloged URL with available content.
Do not promote an index, collection, citation, or normalized record into a course unit without item-level evidence.
Do not fetch, copy, or expose restricted, authenticated, paywalled, sealed, or otherwise unauthorized material.
Record failed or denied access honestly rather than substituting guessed content.
Keep source provenance, content identity, license or use basis, retrieval result, and validator label with every future material artifact.
future_expansion_requirements: Run retrieval as a separately authorized, bounded job.
Use stable locators and captured checksums where content may lawfully be stored.
Validate relevance and availability before declaring a learner dependency.
Label official source material, source-derived metadata, and manager-authored material distinctly.
Update UNIT_GRAPH.json only after deterministic classification.
